property_summary: The legitimate owner (the deployer) can always call AdjustBetAmounts to set betLimit to any uint256 value provided; the mutant inverts onlyOwner so the deployer cannot set betLimit (calls from owner will be rejected) causing betLimit to differ for some fuzzed inputs.
change_summary: Modify onlyOwner modifier to check msg.sender != owner (inverting the check) which will change who can call AdjustBetAmounts and thus change observable betLimit after calls by legitimate owner.
